data.title: bn-xwe: M1.1.1 Domain types, opaque IDs and canonical JSON

data.body: HIGH: The signed and unsigned visitors accept 9007199254740992 and -9007199254740992, while the float visitor rejects 9007199254740992.0. I confirmed all three outcomes at 882b06fd. fixtures/contracts/evidence/run.py:28-36 and 350-381 require rejection on manifest, experiment and verification reads and writes. Pinned Investigation input.rs:179-205 enforces the inclusive ±(2^53−1) bound. An experiment can therefore freeze and hash bytes Investigation refuses to record. Enforce the qualification at structured read and freeze boundaries; retain the full uint range for wire-only counts through a distinct codec if needed. Cover both signs, exact boundaries and nested input, including the qualification fixture.

MEDIUM: The generic canonical writer lets serde_json encode non-finite Rust floats as null before the strict parser runs. A probe at this commit returned Ok("null") for NaN, positive infinity and negative infinity. A caller thus gets exactly the bytes and digest of a genuine null. Reject non-finite floats before this lossy conversion, or expose only inputs that cannot represent non-finite numbers. Cover both non-finite nested fields and a real nullable field.

MEDIUM: The build parses the registry into a plain serde_json::Value, which silently takes the final declaration for a duplicate shape, field, or error exit. The only upfront check is the schema tag. The generator then interpolates field names directly into emitted Rust (line 68) and assumes nonempty ASCII pieces (lines 113-117). The Python contract checker rejects duplicate declarations, but a regular cargo build does not invoke it. Reject duplicate declarations during build, validate names and normalized-name collisions before emission, and exercise a malformed registry in isolation. This concerns changes to the checked-in registry, not runtime input.

data.reason: At 882b06fd8508749abbc194652c6b1402abfa06d8 all 11 focused tests passed, but direct probes verified incompatible structured integer acceptance and non-finite serialization to null. See th-14g8mf and th-qena71 for evidence and fixes, and th-sdjpy8 for build-time registry validation. Re-review the retargeted commit after qualification parity is established.

data.body: Fixed in c4cb206610ae. Evidence reads and canonical writes enforce the inclusive ±(2^53−1) Investigation bound at every depth. The separate machine codec preserves uint values through u64::MAX. Tests cover the qualification fixture, both signs, exact boundaries, record digests and Experiment::freeze.

Fixed in c4cb206610ae. The canonical writer accepts sealed finite-number representations only. Compile-fail doctests cover raw and nested non-finite Rust floats. A required nullable field in the frozen intent still round-trips as JSON null.

Fixed in c4cb206610ae. The build now uses the shared duplicate-free parser and validates Rust names and their normalized collisions before emission. Isolated generator tests exercise malformed registries, including duplicate shapes, escaped duplicate fields and duplicate error exits.

data.body: HIGH: Derived unit enums accept externally tagged JSON objects as well as the registered strings. At c4cb206, wire::from_slice::<RunState> accepted {"finalized":null}, RequestInputV1::read accepted a schema of {"scourge.request-input.v1":null}, and canonical::from_canonical_slice::<VerificationV1> accepted the frozen record with both schema and result replaced by such objects. This contradicts the literal/enum checks in scripts/test-cross-lane-contracts.py and lets a reader accept evidence whose actual JSON type differs from the contract. Generate string-only deserialization for enum values and version tags, with negative tests at the envelope and nested record boundaries.

HIGH: Generated struct deserialization accepts positional JSON arrays for registered object shapes. At c4cb206, ["orders-api",null,0] decoded as Checkpoint, an array [arguments,"verify","scourge.request-input.v1"] passed RequestInputV1::read, and the frozen verification fixture with template replaced by ["example","1"] passed canonical::from_canonical_slice::<VerificationV1>. The frozen validator requires a JSON object for each named shape. Require object-form decoding at every registered shape, including nested shapes. Cover all three normal entry points and confirm valid object fixtures still round-trip.

data.reason: Re-reviewed d2ae7b2..c4cb206. All three previous findings are addressed and 18 focused tests pass. Reviewed d2ae7b21573d98caaa71841afcc30ec3b1090743..76b42aba075c27c2847528b900c0721949585523. All five earlier findings are addressed. Independent probes derived from the frozen registry rejected 65 wrong JSON representations in the verification fixture and three in the normalized request, with InvalidShape for each. Valid fixtures, direct typed readers, nested duplicate keys, both safe integer boundaries, wire u64::MAX and independent run IDs passed. cargo test --locked --offline -p scourge-core passed 4 generator tests, 15 contract tests and 2 compile-fail doctests.
